# BullFrog AI to Present at the 20th Annual LD Micro Main Event on October 20, 2026


October 13, 2026 8:00 am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_71efc5209715f6386a97d32f4b812bec/bullfrogai/news/2026-10-13_BullFrog_AI_to_Present_at_the_20th_Annual_LD_91.pdf)


GAITHERSBURG, Md., Oct. 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- BullFrog AI Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BFRG; BFRGW) ("BullFrog AI" or the "Company"), an AI company using its proprietary platform to turn complex biomedical data into actionable insights, today announced Vin Singh, Founder and Chief Executive Officer, will participate in the 20th Annual LD Micro Main Event being held October 19-21, 2026 at the Luxe Sunset Boulevard Hotel in Los Angeles, CA.


Mr. Singh is scheduled to present to investors on Tuesday, October 20th at 12:30 p.m. PT. Interested parties are invited to watch the live webcast presentation[here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Wk6Av2xXa3S3SmXOlTja8ilvEBGttP4lPueE4zCtFntdKkHPlOK_Cr_mDtdltnK5BfuMEhOFaVzkVNyG3YXdsw==) . In addition, the live webcast and replay can be accessed publicly on BullFrog AI’s Investor Relations website[here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Wk6Av2xXa3S3SmXOlTja8oWohaK6ehpRVHcQBWmfV33cOINRdQVzgFNhSSXAkGlZWOOZgwTVKPhwrBeHptjMfA==) .


During the conference, Mr. Singh will be available for one-on-one institutional investor meetings. To schedule a meeting, please contact your LD Micro representative, or BullFrog AI investor relations at[ir@bullfrogai.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=7NVbZqV0OZ5p1BrjUlH9qeTQfqSiGv0I7DilsN2QHvq_5akhR09SYAxbIoxRz4Euy5rAOzipBYWKgJ7tlEUdPmhJYWLhcu-18_sTyYgoSrs=) .


**About BullFrog AI**


BullFrog AI harnesses artificial intelligence and machine learning to advance pharmaceutical R&D and drug target discovery, providing AI-accelerated outputs that are optimized and human-validated. BullFrog AI operates through three complementary capabilities, deployable independently or as a combined platform: bfPREP™ for biology-aware data harmonization, bfLEAP® for causal AI analytics and patient subgroup discovery, and bfARENAS™ for structured, auditable decision support. The common thread across all three: every output is traceable, every analytical decision is logged, and every recommendation is designed to be reviewed and validated by the scientific team before it drives a decision.


For more information visit BullFrog AI at:[https://bullfrogai.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=yi2z0aVUnuIpuPLlwwOFRMUiNJHB3I1NFNMeWbUWv2LAqd0_QwkVX3U3n-ileyaskcUR4yEX6dpsgA_BhrdClQ8jv7SPvDwRTNHdLH9UEBk=) .
